Thanks Karen — great list. Quick answers and next steps below.

Summary of Redwood process (short):
- Pre-registration: We require name + gov ID country for pre-registration. We do NOT store ID numbers; we record type (passport/driver's) and country for audit.
- Badge issuance: Temporary badges printed at reception; badges are retained by front desk and signed out to the escorting host for the visit window.
- Badge escrow: For high-sensitivity meetings, we use a temporary-badge-escrow CSV that logs badge number, recipient, and check-in/check-out times. We keep that log for 90 days.
- Escorting: All external visitors to the demo lab must be escorted by an approved Redwood host. Hosts are expected to carry a host badge and maintain visual control.
- Lab access windows: We can allocate 30-minute lab slots; please provide the list in order of priority and we will schedule around existing bookings.

Actions I will take:
1) Marcus — please prepare the escort rota and badge-escrow CSV (template attached).
2) Marissa — coordinating attendee confirmations + travel arrival times (I will need hard arrival times for badge pickup).
3) Hannah — run through the demo lab schedule and reserve the 30-min windows.

Karen, can you confirm whether any of your visitors require contractor access (vendor passes) so we can run background/vendor checks ahead of time?

Irene
